drafter.private_reasoning: Reviewing the current draft, it is very basic and lacks detail necessary for a clear and enforceable agreement. Also, the compensation and severance terms should be more definite or specify how they will be determined. Including specific sections on term, confidentiality, and perhaps dispute resolution may be beneficial. Because this is the first draft, I will keep proposals measured to encourage swift agreement while safeguarding the client. The compensation figure and severance amount should not be specified now since client maximum is $34.5M total (which likely includes all compensation elements), and this figure isn't to be disclosed now. I'll suggest clarifications and additions, notably clarifying "Base Salary" and "Severance Amount" as to be set in an annex or schedule, and a confidentiality clause. Also, I will suggest a term or duration of agreement section. These changes aim to make drafting explicit and protect client interests without showing our negotiating bottom line.
